lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We should keep the whole thing quiet, so to speak. The app shouldn't be shouting at you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Like the opposite of the ones that push you a notification right at dinner time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Sotto voce, if you want to be fancy about it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ha. My uncle ran a place called Soto's restaurant, and he had one rule. Never interrupt a table that's enjoying itself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How did he know when to come over, though?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: He waited for the fork to go down. That was the whole signal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's a decent rule for software too. Wait for the fork.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It really is. Quiet by default, helpful when you ask.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And when it does speak, it should have something worth saying, so to speak.
